summary: The UKRI AI Centre for Doctoral Training in Designing Responsible Natural Language Processing at the University of Edinburgh recruits 2027 PhD students with integrated study in two stages. Stage 1 applications close at midnight GMT on 30 November 2026; invited applicants then submit a full application in January 2027. An enhanced stipend of GBP 30,000 a year is expected for Home-fee students starting September 2027.
highlights: Stage 1 application by 30 November 2026, 23:59 (Europe/London) is required for an invitation to Stage 2.
Stage 2 full applications are due in January 2027.
Enhanced GBP 30,000 yearly stipend expected for Home-fee students (TechFirst scheme); overseas applicants receive the standard UKRI rate.
Application status not yet confirmed: verify the dates and requirements on the official Edinburgh CDT page before applying.
